name.zh: 扶椅站姿大腿后侧拉伸

purpose.en: Stretches the back of your thigh while standing.

text.zh: 前脚后跟着地、勾脚尖，上身稍往前倾
text.en: Front heel down, toes up, lean forward a little

text.zh: 一手扶稳椅子，站着那条腿膝盖微弯。
text.en: One hand on a sturdy chair, standing knee soft.

text.zh: 前腿伸直但别锁死，脚尖一直勾着。
text.en: Front leg straight but not locked, toes pulled up.

text.zh: 呼气时屁股往后坐一点，大腿后面有拉就够。
text.en: Each breath out, sit your hips back a bit. A pull behind your thigh is enough.

commonErrors.zh: 手往脚尖够，背弓成一团
commonErrors.en: Reaching for your toes and curling your back.

commonErrors.zh: 后面那条腿也跟着伸直，人往前栽
commonErrors.en: Straightening the back leg too and tipping forward.

cautions.zh: 大腿后面疼或发麻就少往前倾点，还不舒服就停
cautions.en: If the back of your thigh hurts or tingles, don't lean as far. Stop if it still feels off.
